title: Golden Sigils in Void
description: A dark, irregular black mass floats at the center of the frame, covered with numerous glowing golden spiral and circular sigils. It is surrounded by a soft, out-of-focus nebula of cosmic dust and clouds in muted purples, pinks, oranges and greens.
prompt: A mysterious irregular black mass floating in deep space, its rough textured surface covered with intricate glowing golden spirals, loops and sigils. Soft glowing cosmic nebula in muted purples, pinks, oranges and greens surrounds the central dark object, cinematic lighting, ethereal and surreal atmosphere, highly detailed digital painting.
